messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for enterprise customer Carina Health (cust_id: CAR-331) in eu1 dedicated pool. Metrics snapshot: p50=120ms, p95=980ms, p99=3.2s. Affected endpoint: POST /v1/generate (model:redwood-v2-8b-quant). Triggered 2026-03-15T03:12:56Z. Paging oncall @sarah and creating war-room here.

sarah (oncall): I'm on it — starting traces and pulling recent deploys. Anyone seen recent runtime/kernel changes in eu1 last 8h? :eyes:

ben (infra): seeing elevated GPU kernel latency on 2/8 hosts in carina-eu1 pool. Memory pressure + increased memcpy times. Top-of-heap tenants by QPS looks skewed: one tenant at ~65% of requests in last 10m.

omar (runtime): side note — we had a runtime kernel candidate rolled at 00:40 UTC to eu1 canary. I'll check rollout status. If it's the kernel, we should rollback the candidate on a subset before full pool.

priya (customer-eng): I can message Carina PoC (Luca) now: confirm they're seeing errors/timeouts. prepping a short customer note and we should avoid overpromising SLA until we have containment.

ben (infra): quick detective commands:

```
# top tenants by qps
redwoodctl metrics top-tenants --pool carina-eu1 --window 10m

# evict a suspected tenant (dry-run first)
redwoodctl pool evict-tenant --pool carina-eu1 --tenant <tenant-id> --dry-run
```

ben (infra): running the above — got tenant id: carina-analytics-77 at ~65% qps, rising memory allocs.

sarah (oncall): good find. Omar, can we isolate that tenant? prefer eviction -> observe -> possibly throttle. Avoid full pool restart if possible.

omar (runtime): preparing an isolation plan. Plan A: evict tenant from eu1 and route their traffic to eu2 warm spare (if available). Plan B: rollback kernel candidate on affected hosts. I'll start Plan A now as it's lower risk.

incident-bot: Incident severity updated to sev2 by sarah (oncall). Expected handoff window 2-4 hours.

omar (runtime): executing traffic reroute (one-shot) — command:

```
redwoodctl routing set-policy --customer CAR-331 --from-region eu1 --to-region eu2 --percent 100 --grace 30s
```

ben (infra): eviction command (executed):

```
redwoodctl pool evict-tenant --pool carina-eu1 --tenant carina-analytics-77 --force
```

ben (infra): :white_check_mark: eviction successful on 3 hosts. Observability: p99 dropped from 3.2s -> 420ms within 90s. CPU and memcpy latency falling.

priya (customer-eng): pinged Luca: he confirmed reduced error rates on their side and is appreciative of the rapid containment. I'll send an interim status note to Carina: brief summary + ETA for RCA.

sarah (oncall): monitoring the next 30m. If stable, we'll keep the routing split for 1h and then move 10% back every 15m.

omar (runtime): still seeing a small tail on some hosts — opening a kernel rollback ticket for the canary hosts as Plan B. If rollback goes clean, we'll lift routing quicker.

jason (day-oncall): I'm taking primary for follow-up after sarah's shift. please add me to the incident doc and share any logs/trace IDs. I'll own the 08:00-16:00 UTC window.

sarah (oncall): handing off to jason in 12m. Notes: evicted tenant carina-analytics-77 (suspected KV cache fragmentation + high batch sizes). Temporary routing to eu2; p99 stabilized ~ 240-450ms. Open action items: 1) infra to run root-cause sampling on evicted tenant, 2) runtime to validate kernel candidate metrics vs baseline, 3) customer-eng to confirm customer OK with warm-spare routing and next-day RCA call.

omar (runtime): logs/traces saved at: incidents/3242109876/traces.tar.gz. Key trace id sample: trace-CAR331-03-1212. I'll attach a diff of kernel telemetry to the incident doc.

priya (customer-eng): interim customer note sent. Waiting on Carina to confirm acceptance of scheduled RCA tomorrow 10:00 CET.

incident-bot: Reminder: create postmortem workspace and assign action owners within 24h. Template: /playbooks/postmortem-template.

jason (day-oncall): ack, I'll open the postmortem and assign owners: ben (infra) -> tenant isolation analysis, omar (runtime) -> kernel telemetry, sarah (oncall) -> mitigation timeline and playbook updates, priya (customer-eng) -> customer communication log.

sarah (oncall): final note before handoff — mitigation successful, customer impact contained. leaving detailed logs and pinned commands in the doc. handing to jason. :white_check_mark:

jason (day-oncall): taking over — will triage deeper causes and coordinate RCA. If anything regresses ping me directly. :phone:
